stage: Stage 1 bounded synthetic diagnostic; NO CERTIFICATION; NO HISTORICAL ALPHA
limits: Synthetic callbacks, not repaired native model alpha.
Alternate scores deliberately replace conditional_ev ranking input; no true portfolio marginal recomputation.
Cluster penalty uses current positive-opportunity count, not funded holdings or fitted covariance.
Rank shuffle permutes queue scores only; native entry/exit signals stay fixed.
Equal eligible requests min(10%, 1/positive-EV-count) on entry with alphabetical cash rationing; not continuous equal-weight rebalance.
Buy-hold requests 1/24 in every asset on first close, subject to identical cash/risk gates and costs.
20% MDD latch blocks new risk, does not guarantee 20% realized maximum loss.
Modeled trade risk gate is per position, not aggregate portfolio risk.
Oracle intentionally encodes the exact forward move as its creation-time predictor.
Last two predictor observations have no in-window markout and are excluded from calibration.
One synthetic year; CAGR is annualized scenario arithmetic; correlated observations are not independent trials.
Correctly calibrated null EV is always negative after costs, so null abstention does not test robustness to positive EV miscalibration.

execution_correction.reason: Preserve positive-EV admission mask in rank shuffle; collapse tied null EV calibration to one bin.

methodology.execution: close t decision, open t+1 fill, open t+2 forward markout
methodology.calibration_net_cost: Subtract fixed 30bp round-trip allowance from both expected and realized one-session simple returns.
methodology.exit_rule: gross EV < -15bp, or rank below top 10 and top-10 cutoff exceeds incumbent by 40bp with positive entrant net EV.
methodology.gap_risk: Fixed synthetic stress estimates 3%,6%,12%,24%; not fitted to or validated by the price DGP.
methodology.rank_shuffle: Permute positive scores among positive candidates at each close; preserve all admission masks and native signal rules.
methodology.turnover: Sum absolute executed dollar notional / same-day close NAV; buys and sells both count.
methodology.costs: Illustrative small-liquid-trade assumptions, not a fitted liquidity or cost model.
methodology.controls: Cash and buy-hold use the same actual run_slice/Replay.day path; same dates, tapes, settlement, costs and risk policies.

findings.status: Stage 1 executed; functional evidence only; hard stop; no certification

limitations_and_failure_reasons.reason: Risk and cluster comparisons replace the conditional_ev ranking value with explicit adapter scores; these values are not calibrated EV fractions.
Strong rank-shuffle CAGR exceeds baseline by 2.419 percentage points on average; weak differs by only 0.299 points. Oracle is strongly rank-sensitive.
Risk score strong mean CAGR is 1.773 points below baseline; cluster is 2.869 points above with 8/12 wins and seed standard deviation 8.819 points. Weak cluster is identical to baseline.
Null conditional mean EV is negative after costs; no manager entries. This does not establish rejection of falsely positive EV estimates.
2% gate is per-position modeled loss; 20% policy is a latched admission block. Main runs do not exercise the MDD latch; the separate opening-gap probe does.
Manager clips entry/add targets to 10% and passes no scaling evidence. No 15-20% scaling runs.
Known Gaussian generator, persistent planted alpha, static gap estimates, no liquidity/borrow/tax model. Large synthetic CAGRs and Calmar values have no historical-alpha interpretation.
